label: Action
definition: Successful task-level action; currently represented by Correct Action.

label: Exploration
definition: Navigation or information exploration: opening windows, checking the global leaderboard, or logging in.

label: Command manipulation
definition: Direct Git command manipulation; represented by Execute Git Command.

label: Instructional material/help
definition: Use of instructional or conversational support: game manual, hint, answer, or last conversation.
included_events: Read GameManual; Use Hint; Use Answer; Last Conversation

label: Failure
definition: Unsuccessful behavior or unresolved stage exit: failed action, unclear restart, or return without clearing.
included_events: Failed Action; Restart Stage(Not Clear); Back To Stage Select(Not Clear)

label: Reward/progression
definition: Quest/stage progression or reward-related activity: add/complete quest, start/complete stage, or clear-stage return/restart.
included_events: Add New Quest; Complete Quest; Complete Stage; Start Stage; Back To Stage Select(Clear); Restart Stage(Clear)
